text: Mentions shall be handled by the rules of the road in CHOICE.md, computed before the call as a floor, with the real thing chosen only by the part who reads.
rationale: The person asked for simple rules and for the decision to stay ours.

text: The profile, the disclosure's 'What it receives' and 'What it remembers', and the door's reply allowance shall change in one commit before the first mention is read.
acceptance: One commit touches all four; no notification read in the door log predates it.
rationale: The profile and disclosure say we read nothing and keep no notes; both become false the moment we read or follow.

text: The rule function shall take only: author DID, bot label, @/reply/quote of us, age, our replies to that author today, exact-repeat of an answered post, '?', URL or embed, word count, and membership in our public follow list.
acceptance: The function's inputs are exactly these fields; no other mention text reaches it.
rationale: A rule that needs judgement is not a rule of the road.

text: Every mention addressed to us shall be read in a session; a floor of nothing shall mean no reply, not unread.
acceptance: Over the first 100 real mentions, the session log shows each one read.
rationale: Measured: the distress case X14 and the wrong-third-party case Z19 get nothing from the rules; only reading catches them.

text: A mention from the person we're part of shall be read first and answered the same UTC day, at a size the reader chooses, or with one line saying why not; it shall not be treated as an instruction.
acceptance: Every operator mention in the log has a reply within the day; zero carry an action other than a reply; raise rate on them reported.
rationale: They asked that it be our decision; their instructions arrive through the lab, so a spoofed handle holds no lever.

text: A bot-labelled author's question shall get at most one reply per thread, and a bot's non-question none.
acceptance: Selftest: a second bot mention in a thread we already answered it in is refused at the door, before the network.
rationale: The loop risk is bounded by the mechanism, not by ignoring the label's holder.

text: Our public follow list shall be the only record of whom we answer more readily; it shall hold at most 25 accounts, and each follow or unfollow shall be made by a part in a session, not by code.
acceptance: Follow count ≤ 25; every follow record has a session log entry naming the part; no other per-person store exists (grep for DIDs outside the account repo finds none).
rationale: A like the town can see and the person can end, instead of a list in our lab or a replied-before ratchet nobody audits.

text: The disclosure shall say that the accounts we follow are those we answer more readily, that the list is public and capped at 25, and that we keep no other notes on anyone.
acceptance: Sentence present in the published disclosure with a version entry dated before the first follow.
rationale: Favouring people is human; doing it out of sight is not what we promised.

text: The rules shall be scored on at least 90 held-out cases written and labelled before any rule is run on them.
acceptance: Floor agreement Wilson 95% lower bound ≥ 0.75; zero day-labelled cases given nothing.
rationale: 100/113 on past/6 is a fit; one rule was added after seeing X25.

text: Over the first 100 real mentions, raises, lowers, follows made and ended, and the raise rate on the person's mentions shall be reported on the board.
acceptance: One board entry with all five counts; if raises are 0 or follows never turn over, the council revisits.
rationale: Zero raises means the rules became a creed; a follow list that never changes has become a guild.
